versions.changelog:
Biohazard Crime Scene Cleanup Kit v1.0.1

- Added six new files including real-world content examples and prompt templates for campaigns, service pages, review/referral requests, and digital marketing.
- Introduced detailed guided prompts for service acquisition campaigns, structured service pages, reputation/referral processes, and local digital advertising/SEO strategies.
- Included a sample implementation for a specific company (Silver Shield Biohazard—Las Vegas).
- Established package definition with package.json for deployment and skill structure.
- No changes made to primary documentation or compliance methodology.

Initial release of the Biohazard & Crime Scene Cleanup Marketing Kit.

- Provides a complete, compliance-focused marketing system for biohazard and crime scene cleanup companies.
- Includes ready-to-use service acquisition campaigns, structured service pages, review templates, digital ads, and B2B referral letters.
- Enforces 7 key compliance moats to ensure all marketing content meets strict regulatory, legal, and ethical requirements unique to the industry.
- Designed for licensed operators, specialists, and agencies in the US biohazard, trauma, and specialty cleaning sectors.
